title: Is ChatGPT a Sufficient and Readable Help Tool for the Most Frequently Asked Questions in General Dentistry?

live_model.evidence: "questions were then posed to the GPT-4-turbo model available under the ChatGPT Plus plan (Table 1)"; answers rated for accuracy (Likert) and readability (SMOG/Flesch-Kincaid).

prompt.note: Single-turn questions, no system prompt described.

claim.metric: accuracy Likert rating / readability (SMOG, FKGL, FRES)
claim.location: Tables 2-4 (ICC-based accuracy/readability scoring of the 40 answers)

data.source: 40 questions printed in Table 1 (web-sourced FAQ compilation)

notes: Accessed through the ChatGPT Plus consumer interface, not the API, so the exact served snapshot/decoding settings cannot be pinned or scripted for a 3-seed rerun.
